logic: High-volume, less-crowded acceptance of a frozen 96h external boundary. Realize 2/3 at +1.5R to lock +1R gross; retain 1/3 only when a separate completed-hour promotion is already causally known at target, then exit on original stop, protected-boundary state loss, or opposite 48h channel.

product_neutrality.meaning: Products are testbeds. Thresholds are pooled over all 2021 BTC/ETH sides; absolute market units are normalized.

programization_corrections: Completed breakout-hour volume is standardized against the previous 168 completed hours only.
Latest funding is standardized against the previous 90 completed funding observations only.
Volume and signed-funding thresholds are pooled across all 2021 BTC/ETH symbols and both directions; no product/side selection.
The runner is allowed only when a distinct later completed-hour promotion is already causally usable by the +1.5R target time.
Two-thirds is realized at +1.5R, locking exactly +1R gross; the remaining one-third exits only on original stop, protected-boundary state loss or opposite 48h channel.
One global slot, fixed 500ms activation represented by the first strictly later observed minute, actual funding, adverse barrier ordering, and no elapsed-time close.

conclusion.core: The same economic event has a small repeatable full-realization component, but official 24bp median is negative and growth is only 0.00948%/day.
conclusion.hybrid: Causal promotion plus a one-third runner restores a positive median and winner-removal survival, but growth is only 0.01618%/day and the last two half-years are negative.
conclusion.ml: Both entry-time and target-time action-value overlays were inferior or sparse; the component is not yet an ML system.
conclusion.risk: Pre-2024 downside selection retains 0.5% risk. Even impossible official-period risk/cap selection tops at 0.27689%/day with 74.18% MDD; no path reaches 1%.
conclusion.scale: Adding 24/48/168h hierarchy increases trade count by importing negative-median events; the 96h family is not to be retuned further.
